Notes: ROUND AN - THE BREWING MINI-GAMES (Anthony, 8 Oct: very simple flash games, 1-2 actions, 5-15 seconds). One row per BrewerySections.csv machine. KIND: bar (a marker sweeps back and forth, click or Space in the gold; HITS = how many in a row), hold (hold the mouse or Space to fill, let go in the gold; past the top is spilled), mash (click fast, the meter drains on its own; HITS = clicks to fill it). SECONDS = the time limit. ZONE = how wide the gold is, as a share of the bar, for a 100% brewer: a less trained brewer gets less of it (his Brewers.csv Success %), so an untrained hand fails more. SPEED: bar = sweeps a second, hold = bar filled per second of holding, mash = meter lost per second. Lose = the batch is spoiled. No row = no game, the batch is rolled on the brewer's % as before. Tuning.csv brewery_minigames false turns them all off.
